notes.title: Update 1.2.0 - More languages & Oculus Rotation Support
notes.content:
Dear players,

we have just updated 'Above the Clouds' to version 1.2 - we now include support for French, Chinese, Korean, and Thai in addition to English, German, and Spanish. 

As requested, we have also added the ability for Oculus users to rotate the view with the stick to allow playing the game in 180° setups.

Enjoy!

Philip (Sourcenity)

notes.title: Now available in German and Spanish!
notes.content:
To slightly ease your escape from the Mile High Building, we've just pushed version 1.1 with full language support for German and Spanish to the Steam servers. Upon Steam restart, your game will automatically update.

To start the game in either German or Spanish, make sure your Steam interface language is set accordingly. If you want to change the language of this game only, go to the game properties in the Steam library, where you can select the language in the respective tab.

Other updates in this version include graphics improvements (nicer shadows), a fourth quality setting (for low-end hardware and issues on Windows 7), a change to the cables in the fuse box to make it easier to distinguish their sources and targets, and a few smaller fixes.

Enjoy!

notes.title: Now with Windows Mixed Reality support
notes.content:
Dear players,

Valve have released an early access version of support for the Windows Mixed Reality headsets and controllers using SteamVR with a free add-on which can be downloaded here: 

http://store.steampowered.com/app/719950/Windows_Mixed_Reality_for_SteamVR/

We've updated our game to fully support Windows Mixed Reality Headset plus the motion controllers - in full room scale. Support is built in, so you don't have to do anything.

Since the add-on is still Early Access, there may be some issues yet. If you find any, let us know.

Enjoy!
